from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess

BASE = Path('/workspace/scratch/b4a17a285e23/fdsa-restored-20261104')
CTRL = BASE / 'fdsa-control'
PROJECT = BASE / 'conaled-ch01-review'
ROOT = PROJECT / '.lake/build'
OUT = CTRL / 'provenance/foundation-generated-setup-retirement-20261104'
F = 'f17cc6b1a2bf44215b16202ed0fcee2b5c130761'


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def md(s):
    return [s.st_mode, s.st_dev, s.st_ino, s.st_nlink, s.st_size,
            s.st_mtime_ns, s.st_ctime_ns, s.st_blocks]


def git(repo, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), *args], text=True)


def encode(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) + '\n').encode()


def save_new(name, data):
    with (OUT / name).open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())


def descend(parent, parts):
    fd = os.dup(parent)
    for part in parts:
        child = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
        os.close(fd)
        fd = child
    return fd


def inventory(fd, prefix=''):
    rows = {}
    for name in sorted(os.listdir(fd)):
        rel = prefix + name
        s = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
        if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode):
            child = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
            try:
                rows.update(inventory(child, rel + '/'))
            finally:
                os.close(child)
        else:
            assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode), rel
            rows[rel] = md(s)
    return rows


assert not OUT.exists(), 'One-use method; never rerun this mutation directory'
assert git(PROJECT, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip() == F
assert git(PROJECT, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all') == ''
assert git(BASE / 'conaled', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip() == F

assert accepted['candidate'] == F and accepted['standards'] == accepted['spec'] == 'passed'
assert accepted['immediate_verification']['actual_exit'] == 0
assert accepted['integration']['actual_fast_forward_exit'] == 0

source_ids = {
    source_root / 'lake/Lake/Build/Actions.lean': '9c7d7101f89eb1d0618d8a76b86c30d628932ed2d2088db29792fdf88fb1e870',
    source_root / 'lake/Lake/Build/Module.lean': 'c67fff2c7bd95671b49ea64482c4f843f55fefdc4c038858f22a269f0b070b69',
    source_root / 'lake/Lake/Config/Module.lean': '87c14d8552b5115d2c1e0f22436ae6f7b5d03b8ccec125d2991327dc55535455',
    source_root / 'Init/System/IO.lean': '409886ee25dd6ee5455dbb83269edbef98012dd22c5b6c45198b47514aeaca25',
    PROJECT / 'scripts/lake_integrity.py': '293c1e5bbf1a818b9fa49455194afc6e58d28b4194d5f6d2b7a2948f7894d90f',
    PROJECT / 'scripts/check.py': '80794fe95dd2f15ac872da3b6908921ef2898635911832ce0993176308288a29',
}
for path, expected in source_ids.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected
refs_before = git(BASE / 'conaled', 'for-each-ref', '--format=%(objectname) %(refname) %(symref)')
status_before = git(BASE / 'conaled', 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
verification_before = (PROJECT / '.lake/verification.json').read_bytes()
fd = os.open('/', os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
try:
    chain = []
    for part in ROOT.parts[1:]:
        child = os.open(part, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=fd)
        os.close(fd)
        fd = child
        s = os.fstat(fd)
        chain.append([part, s.st_dev, s.st_ino])
    assert chain[-1][1:] == [27, 943030]
    ir = os.stat('ir', dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
    assert stat.S_ISDIR(ir.st_mode) and [ir.st_dev, ir.st_ino] == [27, 944662]
    before = inventory(fd)
    targets = {p: m for p, m in before.items() if p.startswith('ir/') and p.endswith('.setup.json')}
    preserved = {p: m for p, m in before.items() if p not in targets}
    assert len(before) == 7728 and len(targets) == 966
    assert sum(m[4] for m in targets.values()) == 1468681820
    assert sum(m[7] * 512 for m in targets.values()) == 1470791680
    assert all(m[3] == 1 for m in targets.values())
    assert len({(m[1], m[2]) for m in targets.values()}) == len(targets)
    hashes = {}
    for rel, expected in targets.items():
        parts = Path(rel).parts
        parent = descend(fd, parts[:-1])
        try:
            leaf = os.open(parts[-1], os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
            try:
                assert md(os.fstat(leaf)) == expected
                h = hashlib.sha256()
                while True:
                    data = os.read(leaf, 1024 * 1024)
                    if not data:
                        break
                    h.update(data)
                assert md(os.fstat(leaf)) == expected
                hashes[rel] = h.hexdigest()
            finally:
                os.close(leaf)
        finally:
            os.close(parent)
    assert inventory(fd) == before
    OUT.mkdir()
    method = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    save_new('executed-method.json', encode({'script': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(method).hexdigest(), 'source_utf8': method.decode()}))
    pre = {'utc': now(), 'candidate_already_accepted': F, 'root': str(ROOT), 'chain': chain,
           'target_metadata_columns': ['mode', 'dev', 'ino', 'nlink', 'size', 'mtime_ns', 'ctime_ns', 'blocks'],
           'targets': targets, 'complete_target_sha256': hashes,
           'preserved_count': len(preserved), 'preserved_metadata_sha256': hashlib.sha256(encode(preserved)).hexdigest(),
           'refs_sha256': hashlib.sha256(refs_before.encode()).hexdigest(),
           'verification_sha256': hashlib.sha256(verification_before).hexdigest(),
           'source_qualification': {str(p): v for p, v in source_ids.items()},
           'scope': 'Only generated module setup JSON payloads. Every compiler artifact, hash, trace, source, dependency, runtime and ref is preserved.',
           'regeneration': 'Pinned Lake compileLeanModule rewrites setup unconditionally before Lean; lake lean generates a fresh temporary setup. Do not manually replay old lean --setup paths. No companion invalidation or new fresh-check trigger.'}
    save_new('immediate-preflight.json.gz', gzip.compress(encode(pre), mtime=0))
    changed = 0
    try:
        for rel, expected in targets.items():
            parts = Path(rel).parts
            parent = descend(fd, parts[:-1])
            try:
                leaf = os.open(parts[-1], os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=parent)
                try:
                    assert md(os.fstat(leaf)) == expected
                    os.ftruncate(leaf, 0)
                    os.fsync(leaf)
                    after = os.fstat(leaf)
                    assert after.st_size == 0 and after.st_blocks == 0
                    changed += 1
                finally:
                    os.close(leaf)
            finally:
                os.close(parent)
        after = inventory(fd)
        assert set(after) == set(before)
        assert {p: m for p, m in after.items() if p not in targets} == preserved
        assert all(after[p][4] == after[p][7] == 0 for p in targets)
        assert refs_before == git(BASE / 'conaled', 'for-each-ref', '--format=%(objectname) %(refname) %(symref)')
        assert status_before == git(BASE / 'conaled', 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
        assert git(PROJECT, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all') == ''
        assert verification_before == (PROJECT / '.lake/verification.json').read_bytes()
        v = os.statvfs(BASE)
        result = {'utc': now(), 'outcome': '966 generated setup payloads zero-sized and zero-block within command; separate persistence pending',
                  'retired_count': changed, 'prior_allocated_bytes': 1470791680,
                  'compiler_artifact_hash_trace_files_preserved': len(preserved),
                  'preserved_metadata_sha256': hashlib.sha256(encode(preserved)).hexdigest(),
                  'source_refs_and_verification_unchanged': True,
                  'available_bytes': v.f_bavail * v.f_frsize, 'raw_free_bytes': v.f_bfree * v.f_frsize,
                  'space_guards_unchanged': True, 'no_builder_started': True}
        save_new('execution-result.json', encode(result))
        print(json.dumps(result))
    except Exception as exc:
        save_new('failure.json', encode({'utc': now(), 'retired_count': changed, 'error': repr(exc), 'blind_retry_forbidden': True}))
        raise
finally:
    os.close(fd)
